svg.title: Ayyub Khan — Software Engineer and Builder of Weird Tools
svg.desc: Minecraft twilight landscape for Pikachu-5. Steve mines cobblestone, collects the drop, and an Enderman replaces the block before teleporting back with another spare in an endless eight-second scene. Dimensional lettering, diamond ore, a waterfall, an oak tree, and a glowing Nether portal. C++, .NET, and Python appear in an inventory bar.
